deploy-bot: :rocket: Deploy started — environment=staging · service=inference-runtime · tag=release/v2.4.1 · commit=ab3f7d4 · build=ci-20260320-8743 · initiated_by=@emily.ng · strategy=canary(10%)
emily.ng: Kicking this off now. smoke tests + perf slice for 30m. ping me if anything spikes. :eyes:
raj.kapoor: noted, I'll watch the canary metrics and taint if latency > 200ms p95 for >5m
deploy-bot: canary rollout 10% -> 10 hosts. health checks passing (initial). telemetry: p50=18ms p95=92ms errors=0
oliver: quick question — did we pin quantization profile for this release? want to avoid surprises with new kernels
emily.ng: yes, pinned profile `q8_fast_v2` in the release manifest. verified in staging smoke run locally.
deploy-bot: :warning: smoke test failure detected on canary host canary-07
deploy-bot: failing checks: integration/s3-log-rotation (exit=1) — sample log: ```2026-03-20T15:07:22Z ERROR log-rotator: failed to stat /var/log/inference/app.log: permission denied```
raj.kapoor: hmm looks like the log-rotator container doesn't have the new service account role on that host. might be an infra drift in the canary pool.
oliver: ok let's isolate — hold the rollout at 10% and run targeted debug on canary-07. don't advance. :hand:
emily.ng: holding rollout. tagging incident and notifying SRE. @sre-oncall-bot can you collect host-level logs and cpu/mem for canary-07?
sre-oncall-bot: Collecting diagnostics for canary-07: journalctl, dmesg, and `kubectl describe pod` — uploading to https://artifacts.redwood/dev/diag/1769009999-canary-07
raj.kapoor: quick fix possible: reapply proper RBAC role to node pool; but we should avoid pushing config changes mid-rollout. recommend rollback the canary to 0% and pin back to release/v2.4.0 in staging while we investigate.
emily.ng: I agree. rollback canary to 0% and mark this deploy aborted for staging. create follow-up ticket for infra drift and re-run CI with a focused smoke job against canary pool.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated — target=staging · service=inference-runtime · rolling_canary=10% -> 0% · action=abort_canary · initiated_by=@emily.ng
deploy-bot: rollback completed — staging now pinned to tag=release/v2.4.0 · commit=7f9c1a2 · build=ci-20260312-4281 · note=canary_abort_due_to_infra_drift
emily.ng: thanks everyone. I'll open the incident and link diagnostics. tagging @platform-team for the RBAC drift fix.
raj.kapoor: after infra fix, let's run a targeted canary-only deploy (no global rollout) and run the rotated log test 3x before resuming.
oliver: added a small checklist to the release notes in the PR: RBAC-check + node-pool-sanity.
emily.ng: closing out this staging attempt. follow-ups: ISSUE-2985 (infra drift), RETRY-312 (targeted canary run).
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Thread closed — deploy aborted for staging. notifications sent to release-owners and oncall.
